review_policy: Publisher observations and self-written alternatives are not independent linguistic reviews. Oxford dictionary footer/topic/word-of-day CEFR tags must not be attributed to the entry. A qualified independent reviewer must verify the exact sense and CEFR level, Myanmar and example.
source_observation_method: Eight direct publisher dictionary pages opened via web on 2026-11-02; line ranges refer to text-rendered publisher pages; do not treat these locators as persistent source hashes.

frozen_first_pass.english_definition: To make an existing problem or unpleasant situation worse.
frozen_first_pass.burmese_meaning: ရှိပြီးသား ပြဿနာ သို့မဟုတ် မကောင်းသောအခြေအနေကို ပိုဆိုးစေသည်
frozen_first_pass.example_sentence: Delaying the repairs could exacerbate the water shortage.

source_observation.exact_sense_summary_paraphrase: Make a problem, disease or other bad situation worse; transitive verb.
source_observation.source_limitations: Dictionary entry supports meaning/POS/usage only; no C1 exact-sense CEFR classification established.
source_observation.caution: Oxford Health problems c2 is a TOPIC label, not a CEFR rating of this word.

records.editorial_risk: Original definition unnecessarily restricts to an existing problem; example is grammatical and fits the transitive use.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: To make a problem or an unpleasant situation worse.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ပြဿနာတစ်ခု သို့မဟုတ် မကောင်းသောအခြေအနေတစ်ခုကို ပိုမိုဆိုးရွားစေသည်။
unapproved_teaching_alternative.original_example_sentence: A lack of clean water could exacerbate the health crisis.

frozen_first_pass.english_definition: To show that someone is not responsible for an alleged wrongdoing.
frozen_first_pass.burmese_meaning: စွပ်စွဲထားသော အမှားအတွက် တာဝန်မရှိကြောင်း သက်သေပြသည်
frozen_first_pass.example_sentence: New evidence helped exonerate the wrongly accused driver.

source_observation.exact_sense_summary_paraphrase: Officially state that an accused or blamed person is not responsible; verb takes a person as object.
source_observation.source_limitations: Dictionary entry supports meaning/POS/usage only; no C1 exact-sense CEFR classification established.
source_observation.caution: Official declaration is integral; finding evidence or personally believing innocence alone is not the same act.

records.editorial_risk: Original definition says 'show' and example only 'helped', obscuring the official statement and exonerate somebody from/of something.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: To officially declare that a person is not responsible for something they were blamed for.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: စွပ်စွဲခံထားရသူတစ်ဦးတွင် သက်ဆိုင်ရာကိစ္စအတွက် တာဝန်မရှိကြောင်း တရားဝင် ကြေညာသည်။
unapproved_teaching_alternative.original_example_sentence: The independent inquiry exonerated the driver after reviewing the CCTV footage.

frozen_first_pass.english_definition: An incorrect belief or argument based on faulty reasoning.
frozen_first_pass.burmese_meaning: မှားယွင်းသော ဆင်ခြင်မှုအပေါ် အခြေခံသည့် အယူအဆ သို့မဟုတ် အငြင်းအခုံအမှား
frozen_first_pass.example_sentence: It is a fallacy to assume that expensive products always last longer.

source_observation.exact_sense_summary_paraphrase: Countable: a widely believed false idea; also uncountable/countable: faulty reasoning.
source_observation.source_limitations: Dictionary entry supports meaning/POS/usage only; no C1 exact-sense CEFR classification established.
source_observation.caution: Two distinct Oxford senses and countability patterns; do not collapse a popular false belief and a reasoning error.

records.editorial_risk: Frozen definition merges senses, while example illustrates a countable mistaken belief; prefer teaching one sense explicitly.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: A false idea that people believe to be true.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: လူများက မှန်သည်ဟု ယုံကြည်ထားကြသော်လည်း အမှန်တကယ် မှားယွင်းနေသည့် အယူအဆ။
unapproved_teaching_alternative.original_example_sentence: It is a fallacy to believe that every expensive product lasts longer.

frozen_first_pass.english_definition: Showing very strong and sincere feelings or beliefs.
frozen_first_pass.burmese_meaning: ပြင်းထန်ပြီး စိတ်ရင်းမှန်သော ခံစားချက် သို့မဟုတ် ယုံကြည်ချက်ရှိသော
frozen_first_pass.example_sentence: She was a fervent supporter of public libraries.

source_observation.exact_sense_summary_paraphrase: Adjective, normally before a noun, describing strong and sincere feeling or belief.
source_observation.source_limitations: Dictionary entry supports meaning/POS/usage only; no C1 exact-sense CEFR classification established.
source_observation.caution: Collocations include fervent supporter, belief and hope; not necessarily anger or fanaticism.

records.editorial_risk: Frozen English, Myanmar and example align broadly; ensure modifier position and sincerity are retained.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: Showing very strong and sincere feelings or beliefs.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ခံစားချက် သို့မဟုတ် ယုံကြည်ချက်ကို အလွန်ပြင်းပြစွာနှင့် စိတ်ရင်းမှန်ဖြင့် ဖော်ပြသော။
unapproved_teaching_alternative.original_example_sentence: She remained a fervent supporter of public libraries.

frozen_first_pass.english_definition: To motivate people suddenly to take action.
frozen_first_pass.burmese_meaning: လူများကို ရုတ်တရက် စိတ်အားထက်သန်စေပြီး လှုပ်ရှားဆောင်ရွက်စေသည်
frozen_first_pass.example_sentence: The flood warnings helped galvanize local volunteers.

source_observation.exact_sense_summary_paraphrase: Sense 1: prompt someone into action through excitement or shock; sense 2: coat metal with zinc to resist rust.
source_observation.source_limitations: Dictionary entry supports meaning/POS/usage only; no C1 exact-sense CEFR classification established.
source_observation.caution: British alternative spelling 'galvanise' is explicitly shown; 'galvanize steel' has a separate specialist meaning. Oxford Feelings c2 is a TOPIC label.

records.editorial_risk: Frozen example is plausible but 'warnings helped galvanize' can be sharpened; audio/spelling must align with selected UK headword.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: To prompt people to take action, often by making them feel excited or alarmed.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: လူများကို စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားစေခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် သတိပေးလှုံ့ဆော်ခြင်းဖြင့် လက်တွေ့ဆောင်ရွက်လာစေသည်။
unapproved_teaching_alternative.original_example_sentence: The flood warning galvanised local volunteers into action.

frozen_first_pass.english_definition: Strange because it does not fit the surrounding situation.
frozen_first_pass.burmese_meaning: ပတ်ဝန်းကျင်အခြေအနေနှင့် မကိုက်ညီသောကြောင့် ထူးဆန်းနေသော
frozen_first_pass.example_sentence: The bright plastic sign looked incongruous on the historic building.

source_observation.exact_sense_summary_paraphrase: Adjective: seeming strange or unsuitable in the particular setting.
source_observation.source_limitations: Dictionary entry supports meaning/POS/usage only; no C1 exact-sense CEFR classification established.
source_observation.caution: Do not translate simply as 'different'; incongruity implies a mismatch with context.

records.editorial_risk: Frozen example is natural; suggest slightly smoother Myanmar.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: Strange or unsuitable because it does not fit the situation.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: အခြေအနေနှင့် မလိုက်ဖက်သဖြင့် ထူးဆန်းသလို ဖြစ်နေသော။
unapproved_teaching_alternative.original_example_sentence: The bright plastic sign looked incongruous on the historic building.

frozen_first_pass.english_definition: Careful examination of your own thoughts and feelings.
frozen_first_pass.burmese_meaning: မိမိ၏ အတွေးအမြင်နှင့် ခံစားချက်များကို သေချာစွာ ပြန်လည်ဆန်းစစ်ခြင်း
frozen_first_pass.example_sentence: A period of introspection helped her choose a new career.

source_observation.exact_sense_summary_paraphrase: Uncountable noun: careful examination of one's own thoughts, feelings and motives.
source_observation.source_limitations: Dictionary entry supports meaning/POS/usage only; no C1 exact-sense CEFR classification established.
source_observation.caution: Keep uncountable; distinguish self-reflection from formal psychological assessment.

records.editorial_risk: Frozen meaning omits examining reasons for one's behaviour; example is natural.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: Careful reflection on your own thoughts, feelings and reasons for your actions.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: မိမိ၏ အတွေးများ၊ ခံစားချက်များနှင့် အပြုအမူနောက်ကွယ်ရှိ အကြောင်းရင်းများကို သေချာစွာ ပြန်လည်ဆန်းစစ်ခြင်း။
unapproved_teaching_alternative.original_example_sentence: After a period of introspection, she decided to change careers.

frozen_first_pass.english_definition: To place two things together to highlight their differences.
frozen_first_pass.burmese_meaning: ကွာခြားချက်များ ပိုမိုထင်ရှားစေရန် အရာနှစ်ခုကို ယှဉ်တွဲထားသည်
frozen_first_pass.example_sentence: Curators juxtapose old photographs with recent ones to show how the town has changed.

source_observation.exact_sense_summary_paraphrase: Formal verb: put A beside or with B to show contrast or reveal a relationship; often passive.
source_observation.source_limitations: Dictionary entry supports meaning/POS/usage only; no C1 exact-sense CEFR classification established.
source_observation.caution: Not always about differences: the juxtaposition can reveal an unexpected connection; note 'juxtapose A with B' grammar.

records.editorial_risk: Frozen English restricts meaning to highlighting differences, and example is grammatical but lacks explicit comparative aim.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: To place two things together to show a contrast or reveal a relationship.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: အရာနှစ်ခုကို ကွာခြားချက် သို့မဟုတ် ဆက်စပ်မှုတစ်ခု ပိုမိုထင်ရှားစေရန် ယှဉ်တွဲဖော်ပြသည်။
unapproved_teaching_alternative.original_example_sentence: The exhibition juxtaposes old photographs with new ones to reveal changes in the town.
